title: Site Kit by Google Setup
description: Connect Google services via Site Kit — Analytics, Search Console, Tag Manager, and AdSense.

steps.title: Connect Google Account
steps.instructions: Sign in with the client's Google account or a dedicated agency service account with appropriate property access.

steps.title: Link Search Console Property
steps.instructions: Verify the correct domain or URL-prefix property. Confirm ownership and that the sitemap is submitted.

steps.title: Configure Google Analytics
steps.instructions: Connect GA4 property, enable enhanced measurement as needed, and exclude logged-in admin traffic if supported.

steps.title: Set Up Tag Manager (If Used)
steps.instructions: Connect GTM container when the client manages tags externally. Avoid duplicate Analytics tags from theme or other plugins.

steps.title: Connect AdSense (If Applicable)
steps.instructions: Link AdSense only for ad-supported sites. Place ads via theme blocks or GTM—not duplicate snippets in widgets.

steps.title: Restrict Dashboard Access
steps.instructions: Limit Site Kit module settings to administrators. Confirm editors see only the metrics they need.

steps.title: Verify Tracking on Key Pages
steps.instructions: Use Tag Assistant or GA4 DebugView to confirm page views on homepage, thank-you, and conversion pages.
